files: contracts/paid-board/src/lib.rs (draw, draw_many, PALETTE), new src/free_paint.rs, shared/palette.ts, shared/board.json
goal:
Everything that decides what a paint costs. Spec: docs/payments/2026-11-01-paid-board-revision-spec.md §C2, §P1, §F1, §F2.

SCOPE
- C2: required max_credits on draw and draw_many; reject PriceRoseAboveMax with nothing stored.
- P1: 16-colour PALETTE (Grime & Gum at 8-15) in the contract AND shared/palette.ts + shared/board.json in the same PR; the shared drift test must pass.
- F1: 25 free first paints per registered account until first_fill_complete latches; free paints apply to empty cells first; free cells join free_cells, a paid repaint removes them.
- F2: happy hour per the spec's tunables (Sunday 20:00 UTC, 1 h, 100 per account, base tier only, requires a purchase, only after the latch). Switching off is immediate; on/raising needs the 24 h cooldown. Week maths from the block timestamp (1 Jan 1970 was a Thursday).
- has_purchased: set it from the purchase paths with a one-line call; coordinate with REV-B if it has merged.
- Views: get_happy_hour, get_free_first_paints(account).

ACCEPTANCE
- Every test listed under C2, P1, F1 and F2 in the spec.
- cd web && npm test passes after the shared palette change.

BEFORE YOU START
Read AGENT.md, docs/learning/traps.md and the spec section named above. Contract changes were approved by the owner on 1 Nov for this revision only, on testnet. Do not deploy to mainnet.

DONE MEANS
AGENT.md's definition of done: tests named that fail before and pass after, cargo test / npm test / npm run build as relevant, a '## Learned' line in the PR, and the backlog row's new status written in the PR description (the merger updates docs/backlog.md on main; see AGENT.md).
